newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece to help Albania rebuild its army.
newsitem.headline: Greece to help Albania rebuild its army.

text.p: Greece has agreed to help Albania rebuild its shattered army after the last few weeks of violent turmoil, a Greek government spokesman said on Friday.
"The (Greek) defence ministry has received a letter from the Albanian defence ministry, asking for Greece's help and support in reconstructing the Albanian army," the spokesman said.
He said Greece's immediate response was positive but that a complete study of the problems in the tiny, poor Balkan country was necessary before suggesting specific measures.
"Obviously at this moment there is a situation there where the army is essentially absent," he said. "These structures must be constructed."
Albania plunged into anarchy after the collapse of shady pyramid savings schemes left thousands of families destitute.
